target.label: Story 10.4 — Projection Write Conformance and Recovery Tests

rationale: P0 coverage is 100% (AC#1 BLOCKER preserved at unit tier by T-10.4-CONF-002/003). All 11 ACs have at-least-PARTIAL coverage with passing tests: focused run 23 tests pass (6/6 conformance + 17/17 handler); solution gate 655 passed / 1 skipped (post-Story-11-1). The strict-FULL coverage math falls below PASS thresholds (overall 18%, P1 strict-FULL 0%) because 9 of 11 ACs carry open Review patches — but these are coverage-refinement gaps within already-PARTIAL ACs (sentinel breadth, structured-KV diagnostic assertions, fixture fail-fast semantics, comprehensive 9-event-type ordering, persisted-authoritative-by-contest semantics, missing index-replay idempotency test), NOT blank/NONE gaps. CONCERNS is the appropriate verdict because the story is still in review status with 16 documented Review patches (12 patches + 4 decision-driven D2/D3/D4/D5) pending application before the review→done transition.

strict_rule_outcome.override_rationale: Strict-FULL math undercounts effective coverage in review-stage stories. All 11 ACs are PARTIAL-or-FULL (no NONE gaps); all 23 in-scope tests pass; the gap surface is review-stage refinement patches (sentinel breadth, structured KV assertion, wins-by-contest, fixture fail-fast), not coverage absence. A literal FAIL verdict would misrepresent reality and is inappropriate for a story in review with documented rework pending. CONCERNS is the correct verdict because (a) test gate is green, (b) AC#1 P0 BLOCKER is fully covered, (c) 16 open Review patches across 9 ACs must be applied before story closes review.
